issues.t: Fuel pump outlet hose may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell, a fuel leak under the rear of the car, or the engine suddenly quitting.
issues.why: On some early cars the hose connection at the fuel pump outlet was not secured properly and could slip off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 02V-245. If you smell fuel or see a leak, park the car and have it towed to a dealer.

issues.t: Stalling from crank or cam sensor failure
issues.sym: The engine cuts out while driving, cranks a long time before starting, or will not start, often with a check engine light for a cam or crank sensor.
issues.why: The crankshaft and camshaft position sensors can fail. On early 2003 cars a bad solder joint inside the sensors led to a recall, and owners of later cars report the same sensors failing with age.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 03V-455. If the car stalls or a sensor code appears, have the sensors tested and replaced before driving in traffic again.

issues.sym: Fuel smell or fuel dripping near the right rear of the car, especially right after filling up.
issues.why: The filler hose between the gas cap neck and the tank can crack, and the metal section of the filler neck can rust through, letting fuel leak during refueling.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 05V-555. Do not keep driving or refueling a car that smells of fuel; have the hose replaced first.

issues.t: Timing chain guide and tensioner wear
issues.sym: A ticking, rattling or whining sound from the front of the engine, often worse at startup, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: The plastic chain guides and the tensioner wear over time, and long oil change intervals make it worse. A badly worn chain can jump timing and damage the engine.
issues.next: Have any new ticking or rattling checked promptly. Keep oil changes on time and use the correct oil level.

issues.sym: Needing to add oil between changes, the low oil light coming on, or oil-fouled spark plugs causing a rough idle.
issues.why: Some of these engines burn oil past the piston rings, and leaking valve cover seals can also foul the plugs. Infiniti addressed ring-related consumption in a service bulletin.
issues.next: Check the oil every few fill-ups and keep it topped up. If you add oil often, ask a dealer for an oil consumption test.

issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, a shimmy or shake when braking, or vague, wandering steering.
issues.why: The rubber bushings in the front compression rods crack and tear on this generation, letting the front wheels shift under braking and over bumps.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Worn compression rods or bushings should be replaced, followed by an alignment.

issues.sym: A humming or roaring from the front that grows with speed, and front tires feathered or worn on the inside edges long before the tread should be gone.
issues.why: The front suspension geometry on this generation, combined with soft performance tires, tends to wear the front tires unevenly even when the alignment looks fine.
issues.next: Check tire wear regularly, rotate on schedule, and have the alignment set to Infiniti's latest specifications.

issues.t: Premature front brake wear and squeal
issues.sym: Squealing or grinding when braking, and front pads and rotors that need replacing much sooner than expected.
issues.why: The front brake pads and rotors on these cars wore out unusually fast. Infiniti gave 2003-2004 owners longer brake coverage, and 2005 owners later filed a class action over the same complaint.
issues.next: Have the front brakes inspected at every service. Replace worn pads and rotors promptly, and ask a dealer about any past coverage.

issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on or the passenger airbag status light acts oddly.
issues.why: A wiring harness under the front passenger seat can rub through and lose its signal, so the passenger airbag might not deploy in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 10V-175. Have an airbag light diagnosed right away and keep passengers in the rear seat until it is fixed.

issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light stays on with an adult in the seat, or the airbag warning light comes on.
issues.why: A part inside the passenger seat occupant sensor could be out of specification, making the system think the seat is empty and turn the passenger airbag off. This affected 2007-2008 G35 sedans and 2008 G37 coupes.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 08V-521. If the passenger airbag shows off with an adult seated, have it tested before carrying a front passenger.

issues.sym: The dash top turns sticky or shiny, then bubbles, cracks or peels, often worst near the windshield and defroster vents, causing glare.
issues.why: The dashboard surface material breaks down with sun and heat on this generation.
issues.next: Ask an Infiniti dealer about goodwill help, since some owners have had dashes replaced. A dash cover cuts the glare in the meantime.

issues.sym: The oil pressure light flickers at hot idle, a check engine light appears for valve timing, the engine goes into reduced power, or it starts ticking.
issues.why: Paper gaskets that seal oil passages behind the timing cover can break down, causing a sudden drop in oil pressure. Nissan later switched to a revised gasket.
issues.next: Stop the engine if the oil pressure light comes on and have the car towed. The repair replaces the gallery gaskets behind the timing cover.

issues.sym: The car will not start, the steering wheel stays locked, a steering lock message appears, or the electrical system shuts down.
issues.why: The electronic steering column lock can jam or fail internally, so the car never unlocks the steering and refuses to start. A revised part was used later.
issues.next: If the lock acts up, have it diagnosed before you get stranded. A failed lock needs replacement.

issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on, or the passenger airbag shows off with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: The occupant sensing system in the front passenger seat can fail, which disables the passenger airbag.
issues.next: Have an airbag light diagnosed right away and keep passengers in the rear seat until the sensor is repaired.

issues.sym: An automatic window keeps closing on an object or hand instead of backing off.
issues.why: A programming error in the power window switch on some G37 coupes made the auto-reverse need too much force to trigger.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 11V-538 and have the switches replaced. Keep hands and children clear of closing windows until then.
